changelog:
### Privearch v1.0.0 Stable Release
- Dual-Model Brain-Trust (0.5B Router + 4B Synthesizer + 0.5B Verifier)
- 100% Local Airgap (Zero Cloud Compute, CPU embeddings + 4GB VRAM)
- Hybrid In-RAM Retrieval (Okapi BM25 + FAISS RRF)
- Pre-Indexed 29 NCERT Chemistry Textbooks (2,280 semantic chunks)
- Native Windows Executables (Privearch.exe, Privearch-Terminal.exe, Privearch-Setup.exe)
- Zero-Trust Over-The-Air (OTA) Update Engine with Automatic Rollback
